title: Chinna Durai
desc: Chinnadurai, a village do-gooder, helps people in distress but earns the enmity of a fellow villager Ponnambalam. Later, Ponnambalam tries to poison Chinnadurai, but he survives.

title: Aattanayagann
desc: Lingam is shocked after his sister-in-law informs him that his brother, Chandran, is a dreaded gangster. To set things right, Lingam decides to reform his brother.

title: Thirumoorthy
desc: Murthy, a truck driver, fights against a corrupt politician, Sigamani, and contests in the elections against one of his aides. However, things take a turn when he becomes a murder suspect.

title: Parijatham
desc: Surendhar's mother tells him that she has found him a bride. Before the couple can meet, his mother dies in an accident. He sets out to find the woman his mother wanted him to marry.

title: Mettukudi
desc: A man pretends to be the son of a long-lost royal family to steal a precious sword. However, his plan runs into complications when the granddaughter of the sword's guardian falls in love with him.
